summary: Adds standalone local parametric CAD with exact modelling, geometry exchange and shared human/agent workflows connected to CAM. Normal solid views smooth near-smooth display seams; Edge mode retains complete native topology. Modeling precision, saved geometry, installed post contracts and exports are unchanged by this display repair. Shared buttons, fields, styled dropdown pickers, command menus and accessible help now use one compact theme throughout CAD, CAM, the library and settings.
warning: Installed post packages, saved CAM revisions, post execution events and controller output contracts are unchanged. CAD handoff creates a new detached CAM project; review its contours, threading and machining setup before generating output. A numerical roundoff correction can classify freshly calculated nearly tangent intersections differently; existing saved geometry and output are not rewritten. Exact section transfer refuses unsupported or ambiguous curves instead of approximating them. Gear v2 uses bounded involute and rack-generated trochoidal root approximations. Legacy v1 radial roots remain pinned until an explicit upgrade. API 2 plugin profiles require a reader supporting derived rules; earlier plugin previews reject them. Nominal geometry does not certify strength or mating clearance. Optional CAD parameter-group and creation-origin fields require a current CAD reader. Older strict CAD previews may reject these documents; original saved documents are not migrated automatically. Spur gear v3 adds an explicitly selected generating-cutter tip radius and tighter certified chord sampling. Existing v1/v2 recipes and installed snapshots retain their exact package definitions and geometry. Older CAD readers without the v3 builtin reject new v3 profiles; no automatic upgrade occurs. Sketch profiles may now store optional driving-dimension intent. Current readers preserve old geometry and expressions without adding constraints; older strict CAD previews may reject profiles using the new field. No saved document migration occurs. Cut in Pad, Revolve, Loft, Sweep and Boolean now requires confirmed positive intersected material. Saved cuts that previously removed nothing or could not be resolved at native precision may now report a feature diagnostic and stop rebuilding; their saved definitions remain unchanged. Check sketch placement, direction, depth and target. The preceding valid solid remains visible and invalid solid export is blocked. CAD source, document, saved-file, STEP root/solid, STL facet and preview topology byte/count policy ceilings are removed without changing the file schemas or requested geometry. Older preview readers can reject newly accepted larger files or journals. Existing saves and installed post packages are not rewritten. Invalid encoding, units, geometry, cancelled or stale operations still fail before acceptance; connected-shell STL reconstruction and existing operation semantics remain unchanged. Nested conversion-based STEP length units now report step-units-unsupported before transfer because the pinned native reader can silently substitute the wrong scale. Previously accepted shallow nested-unit imports may therefore stop rebuilding; their exact saved originals remain intact. SI units and supported direct conversions remain accurate. CAD context parameters and parameterGroups are summaries when their omission flags are true. Agents that require every value must follow the documented versioned read tools; full stored data and file schemas are unchanged. CAD viewport and capture ID arrays can now be summaries when their omission flags are true. Exact counts and viewport-token/document-version-pinned pages expose every displayed identity; complete renderer and retained capture metadata are unchanged. Small scene receipts remain complete. Agents must inspect omission flags before treating a returned array as exhaustive. Exact cache and bounded recovery reads now deliberately validate complete gzip member series, including header/footer checksums and trailing bytes, independently of platform decompression behavior. Malformed compressed envelopes previously tolerated by the portable reader now reject without changing or deleting their stored originals. Existing backup/recovery read limits remain separate from uncapped CAD exchange. CAD files authored with explicit regionSelection require a reader supporting that field; earlier strict readers reject them. Existing files without the field keep their previous behavior. Selected Fillet/Chamfer features accept optional tangentPropagation intent. Absence/false preserves strict selected-edge behavior; true explicitly authorizes native tangent continuation from validated seeds. Older strict CAD readers can reject documents storing this field. Existing saved definitions, native geometry precision, installed post packages and CAM schemas are unchanged; no automatic migration occurs.

Earlier CAD preview builds cannot read documents containing those new kinds or placements. Existing CAD documents remain readable without rewriting their geometry. UPID, post, package, engine API and existing workbench schemas are unchanged. CAD saves live in the additive cad/documents namespace. Plugin profiles extend the same unreleased CAD union, embedding an exact plugin API 1 or 2 package and expression-backed inputs. Earlier CAD preview readers reject plugin profiles. No UPID or post schema change is introduced. Plugin API 2 adds explicit derived relations, dependent bounds, conditions, choices and constraints. API 1 originals remain readable and unchanged; the gear implementation changes only through an explicit v2 package selection. CAD documents optionally store parameterGroups and parameterMetadata. Current readers retain old files without synthesizing metadata. Grouping and provenance require current readers; older strict preview readers can reject these optional fields. Spur gear v3 adds an explicitly selected generating-cutter tip radius and tighter certified chord sampling. Existing v1/v2 recipes and installed snapshots retain their exact package definitions and geometry. Older CAD readers without the v3 builtin reject new v3 profiles; no automatic upgrade occurs. Existing extrude and pocket accept optional exact regionSelection cell references. Absence preserves the existing whole-sketch contour order and material parity; explicit selections reject stale nesting without substitution. Earlier readers cannot read this new optional field. No CAD format version, native package, installed post/machine schema, saved CAM revision or pinned plugin upgrade changes. Selected Fillet/Chamfer features accept optional tangentPropagation intent. checklist.events: Post execution-event contracts, compilation, audit and invocation are unchanged. CAD uses its own immutable versioned draft and bounded history. Handoff validates analytic millimetre geometry through the ordinary portable-UPID import operation. Delayed CAD build inspections recheck the active workspace before publication, and the CAD library owns a cancellable workflow scope that blocks background edits and history. Native feature previews use a separate lazy worker with one active and one coalesced latest candidate; provisional edits preserve the accepted document, exact build ownership and one-step Apply history. Context menus and source picking own the same UI workflow guards.
checklist.capabilities: Installed post capability claims are unchanged. Desktop CAD adds automatic sketch regions, directly drawn line/three-point-arc paths, independent open reference curves with exact measurements and DXF exchange, editable analytic imported paths, STEP and closed STL import, selective fillets/chamfers, planar-face inward shells, exact topology inspection, Boolean operations, linear/circular solid patterns, ordered smooth/ruled lofts, exact line/arc sweeps with shared placement and conservative clearance preflight, target-dependent Through-all Pocket with directional extent and native material evidence, and parametric history. Versioned WebMCP tools reuse the same import, edit, build, selection, save and handoff checks. Compact feature registration retains complete per-kind discovery and strict execution validation. Sketch and Curve references render in authored world placement without loading the solid engine; selection reveals source sketches. Curves have no material or CAM roles. GPU-local positions preserve small far-origin faces, edges and reference geometry. World datum planes provide expression-backed origins and rotations for local Sketch/Curve placement and exact Pad/Revolve construction, aligned-section Loft and independently placed Sweep sources. Datum Loft fits in a common local frame before rigid placement, preserving native geometry across world orientation. Shared read-only plane and Loft inspectors expose accepted frames and ordered section eligibility; datum Sweep preserves authored section roll and rail traversal with conservative frame/clearance checks; unsupported datum Through-all Pocket inputs are rejected before editing. Datum references and their captures do not require native solid evaluation. CAD plugins add immutable package installation, a browser authoring/validation panel, bounded polygon recipes and a versioned Spur gear implementation. Read-only discovery and hash-pinned package chunk reads accompany guarded installation; all plugin-generated geometry uses existing sketch checks. Correlated plugin configuration shares its rule evaluator with guarded cad_inspect_plugin reads and atomic edits. The compact profile inspector and searchable library separate authoring from ordinary configuration. Fillet and Chamfer share one toolbar command group. Shared parameter inspection exposes active uses, local inputs, origins and applied values. Exact section DXF export shares the guarded native section operation. The unified history/dependency tree and on-part dimensions do not add modelling feature types. Existing feature forms preview native candidate geometry before Apply, retain the last valid provisional shape while pending, and restore accepted geometry on Cancel. Model/history reference picking observes preceding-feature eligibility and changes only the draft. Dedicated CAD Navigation/Display settings store mouse/trackpad navigation and on-part dimension visibility on the current device; rendered viewport identities expose those effective preferences. Native shape ownership and STL compound cleanup fixes preserve accepted snapshot exports and inspections. Spur gear v3 adds an explicitly selected generating-cutter tip radius and tighter certified chord sampling. Existing v1/v2 recipes and installed snapshots retain their exact package definitions and geometry. Older CAD readers without the v3 builtin reject new v3 profiles; no automatic upgrade occurs. Plugin package registration now uses compact discovery-only envelopes. The read-only cad_describe_plugin_api operation supplies complete strict API 1/2 contracts; actual install and edit validation is unchanged. The internal single-thread CAD kernel now uses file-pinned 1.1.0-wireedm.2 with coupled native ownership repair and additive exact indexed topology extractors. Loader, WASM, generated declarations, both source patches and reproducible build evidence are hash-pinned and distributed together. Legacy extractor geometry, model precision, full native validation and installed user packages remain unchanged. The transparent specification tree overlays the entire canvas with real Reference, Parameters and Model branches. Contextual tools sit at the bottom and configuration at the bottom right. Explicit rectangle, circle and slot dimensions reuse analytic geometry, named bindings and the shared guarded edit API. Direct contour dragging retains dimensions and commits once. Rectangle Sketch Fillet supports expression editing and deliberate unlink with correlated provisional measurements. General path constraint solving is not exposed. All existing Cut families share per-solid native material evidence with Through-all Pocket, rejecting no-effect and unresolved cuts while preserving preceding valid bodies. Contour-label changes reuse native geometry but retain complete accepted-document inspection checks. Viewport ID paging pins both the document version and complete observed metadata token. Capture artifact metadata remains complete even when the returned transport receipt summarizes ID arrays. Missing reference metadata stays unavailable; it is not a zero-count claim. Closed-area selection uses the same validated source forest for UI shading/analytic picking and public cad_inspect_sketch_regions / cad_read_sketch_region_reference. Optional proposed-source reads validate only the requested complete sketch and its actual preceding datum under merged numeric values, never downstream/native certification. Full atomic edit/build guards remain required. Selected Fillet/Chamfer offers explicit Follow tangent edges using the existing native contour builder, including split circular rims, with exact seed guards and provisional Apply/Cancel history.
checklist.auditAndOutput: Existing controller formatting, feed policy and exact-post output remain authoritative. CAD JSON preserves editable history; STEP exports exact BRep, STL exports a mesh, and sketch DXF preserves analytic curves. Failed solid features block solid export. Sketch and solid-section handoffs create separate CAM projects without overwriting prior revisions. Gear v2 nominal root/flank approximation notes survive sketch and final-section CAM transfer without extending UPID diagnostics.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No migration or installed-package rewrite. CAD storage covers browser cache and folder adapters with exact hash conflicts, journal recovery and write-boundary guards. Full workbench backup includes CAD files; cleanup retains the entire CAD namespace. CAD save and CAM creation are separate commits. The lazy OpenCascade worker is distributed with pinned corresponding sources and rebuild instructions. Installed plugin source lives under cad/plugins and is included in existing full-CAD retention/backup. Conflicting ID/version originals cannot be overwritten. Parts embed pinned packages, so library changes cannot rewrite existing geometry. Grouped parameters round-trip through both cache and folder adapters with existing exact-hash conflict checks. Plugin additions create isolated drivers and a group atomically, preserving unrelated parameters and all embedded packages. No automatic migration occurs. Durable CAD save receipts add storageName and draftMarkedSaved. A save committed to a disconnected or previous destination cannot mark the current draft saved or transfer its storage fingerprint. Section CAM handoff validates body, plane, resolved offset and result structure before either persistence operation. Cancellable exact cache/folder reads preserve BOM and original Unicode. The shared file journal retains exact before/after images and its existing recovery format without a fixed byte cap. Compact portable JSON avoids decorative whitespace; storage fingerprints, conflicts and durable cancellation receipts stay exact. Device storage quotas remain observable storage failures. Complete compressed member validation is shared by exact cache and bounded recovery reads, with exact UTF-8/BOM preservation, released cancellation ownership and cooperative work slices. No envelope migration or original rewrite occurs; bounded recovery still stops before retaining excessive decoded text. The optional extrusion-handle preference is device-local, off by default and retains existing preference bytes until an explicit setting change. Existing saved documents receive no implicit selector or rewrite; browser-cache and folder documents use the same additive schema.

Complete GitHub CI38656665972 passes all386 files/4,103 unit cases in257.80s and all125 Chromium journeys:124 first-attempt passes, no failures/flaky retries and the unchanged optional local-folder smoke skip (6.2m). Conformance, machine-package validation, release compatibility, production build, all92 documentation checks and pinned native corresponding-source distribution pass. CI uses Node24.21.0/npm11.19.0, Actionsv7 and Ubuntu24.04; local app/gates use Node24.22.0/npm11.19.1. The final27-path face-scope/quantity repair has independent source-hashed reviews and actual current-bundle native/browser proof. Tiny area, dimensions and native solid volume retain nonzero labels while raw numbers, aliases, full source, accepted version/history and saved-library metadata remain exact. Explicit face Fillet/Chamfer does not expand scope; intentional whole-body/edge workflows remain available. No fixture is saved or preference changed. Assertions, timeouts, retries, native precision, installed posts, output contracts, saved revisions and pinned plugin definitions remain unchanged. Earlier failures and stage-specific gates are preserved in private audit records. The complete icon catalogue is refreshed. General path constraint solving and multi-shell STL reconstruction remain unsupported. The separate native Copy candidate is uninstalled and does not certify a retained-source cache or peak-resource bound. The broad CAD goal remains active. Follow-on selected-edge workflow repair passes independent81 current cases, root25 discovery/agent cases and full app typecheck/build,92 docs and corresponding-source checks. Actual human single-edge tangent preview/Cancel and one-arc bore Apply/Undo/Redo match analytic material and exact original state, with both saved libraries and main draft preserved. Its new optional field is described in the schema warning; complete new-head CI follows publication. Native Copy experiments are completed private evidence, parked and uninstalled; no retained-source cache is included.

testedPosts.scope: Unchanged post passes all three conformance fixtures and complete machine-package validation. CAD does not bypass the existing saved-revision, active-setup or audited output requirements. No physical controller verification is claimed.

publicNotes.summary: Design parametric parts and send exact contours into the machining workbench.
changes: Design in CAD opens a desktop workspace with a compact document header, one ordered feature/dependency tree and a stable canvas. Every configuration floats over the view and can minimize; changing selection no longer shifts the layout.

Create dimension-driven sketches, connected lines and three-point arcs with automatic material nesting, and exact solids with pads, target-dependent Through-all pockets, revolves, ordered smooth/ruled lofts, exact line/arc sweeps, Booleans, selected-edge fillets/chamfers, inward shells, transforms, mirrors and linear/circular patterns. Reuse named parameters in dimension expressions.
Create expression-driven datum planes, place sketches and curves on them, and build tilted pads, revolves, aligned-section lofts or sweeps while preserving local dimensions and source files.
Send a sketch or previewed final-solid section directly into a new CAM project with analytic lines and circular arcs.

Save editable CAD documents locally; import and export CAD JSON, STEP, STL and sketch DXF. Edit imported line and arc dimensions while preserving source originals. Open existing sketches fitted to their geometry, reveal source sketches in 3D, and capture the current view as PNG.

Agents can discover schemas, construct and measure exact line/arc profiles, preflight sweep placement and clearance, import geometry, edit the same draft, inspect exact faces and edges, control the viewport, save and hand off designs through version-checked WebMCP tools.

Configure correlated Spur gear profiles with automatic undercut correction, Automatic/Custom generating-cutter tip radius, bounded rack-generated rounded roots and read-only dimensions. Tooth root and Curve accuracy have dedicated controls with illustrated explanations. Existing parts keep their exact plugin versions until explicitly upgraded.
Open Fillet / Chamfer as a grouped toolbar menu; both operations retain exact selected-edge and all-edge behavior.

Read CAD failures in dismissible toasts and the notification bell. Repeated identical rebuild failures are grouped; dismissing the toast retains the notification for the current app session. Gear root sampling uses fewer certified chords at the same requested tolerance; larger valid extrusions retain their requested accuracy without a preview topology policy cap.

Organize document parameters in named groups with plugin origin indicators. Plugin profiles create their own scoped driving values. Inspect active uses and local overrides, edit values in a floating editor, and use contextual info buttons with current-geometry illustrations.

Keep mouse-drawn contours free until you add a driving dimension. Rectangle, circle and slot dimensions use shape-native annotations; named links remain correlated. Drag selected ordinary contours to move them with one Undo step. Sketch Fillet rounds rectangle corners with a bounded tangent radius; explicit relation editing/unlinking retains other dimensions.

Preview existing modeling feature edits before Apply; right-click parts and profiles for compact actions, and pick eligible source sketches/bodies from the model or history without leaving the draft. Settings > CAD provides Navigation and Display tabs for this device.

Use File > Export DXF for a chosen sketch, reference curve or previewed exact solid section at a plane offset. Export is independent of feature properties, does not save the document or create CAM, and keeps version, cancellation and workflow checks.

Sketch profile selection keeps pointer focus on the canvas and uses a continuous analytic SVG boundary, removing oversized browser focus outlines and segment seams without changing export geometry. Spur gear v3 uses fewer certified modeling chords at the same accuracy.

Changed plugin recipes must use a new ID/version when their identity belongs to a bundled package. Conflicting installation is rejected before writes; conflicting stored originals remain intact and appear in library diagnostics.

The specification tree floats directly over the full design area. Its Reference, Parameters and Model branches scroll independently, with distinct contour selection and parent editing context. Contextual commands sit at the bottom; configuration and sketch completion sit at the bottom right without shifting the canvas.

Pad/Pocket and Revolve source selection excludes empty, suppressed and construction-only sketches. Explicit unusable selection reports a problem instead of substituting another sketch; datum sketches keep Distance while Through-all is disabled with contextual help.
CAD requests the browser exit warning only while unsaved content or a pending workflow exists. Save or Undo to the saved baseline releases it; the warning does not save the draft.

Pad, Revolve, Loft, Sweep and Boolean cuts report when they miss the target, point away from it, only touch it or remove the entire body. Native precision checks inspect individual material components; no requested geometry or accuracy is changed automatically.
Renaming a sketch contour reuses the existing native solid; changing a real dimension still rebuilds it. STEP body labels and stale inspection checks remain current.

Sketch is the first modeling command. Select a reference plane before starting, or pick its patch or label in the design area when asked. View controls tuck below the contextual tool dock and slide out without changing canvas framing.

View angles and all platform dropdowns share one native control with consistent readable menu colors, keyboard focus and disabled states. Existing selection choices, labels and form behavior are preserved.

Modeling quantity fields retain shared parameter links and preview correlated features together. Use fx for deliberate relation changes. Editing a named value keeps the current solid or sketch view; Inspect a usage to navigate deliberately. Unfinished values keep the last valid shape visible while Apply remains disabled. Unused parameters reuse native solids while current section queries and stale-state checks remain exact.

Selected body volume and a ready feature preview show native solid counts when a history body contains multiple components. Join/Union help explains containment and separated additions. Agents receive the same derived count, with null for older results where it is unavailable. Saved geometry and Join acceptance are unchanged.

CAD exchange and saved documents have no fixed file-size cap. Larger STEP, STL and exact DXF data retain their complete originals; native builds preserve requested precision. Exact reads and native work remain cancellable. Geometry and unit checks still apply. Healthy workers keep their current build for inspection and export without forced job-count resets.

Agent context and mutation receipts include whole parameter/group entries with exact totals and omission counts. Complete values remain available through versioned parameter pages and document text chunks; large lists do not hide an accepted edit behind an oversized receipt.

Large CAD scenes keep every authored reference outline at its existing accuracy. Viewport reads and captures return complete small scenes or whole-ID summaries with exact counts and pages for all displayed identities. Exact large DXF polylines, nested blocks and CAD-to-CAM contour provenance are preserved without JavaScript argument-count failures.

Opening cached parts and readable recovery data preserves exact text and validates complete compressed files across supported browsers. Cooperative decoding removes unnecessary small-chunk waiting while retaining cancellation and original data.

Sketches stay visible and selectable far from the origin, with exact dimensions and source coordinates preserved. Closing View controls dismisses their contextual help while retaining camera settings and unfinished geometry edits.

Opening a different part frames its own geometry. Edits, previews, Cancel and inspector changes within the same part retain the chosen camera. Initial Sketch Fit accounts for the newly expanded contour tree; manual tree interactions retain the view. Gear-help illustrations preserve proportions and rounded root transitions far from the origin.

Pad and Pocket can select individual closed sketch areas, including bore interiors, while preserving the original sketch and its dimensions. Whole sketch remains the default. Selected nested neighbors share no internal wall; changed area topology requires an explicit new choice.

Optional extrusion depth handles live in CAD Display settings and are off by default. Dragging previews signed or symmetric Length, preserves exact named parameter bindings and waits for Apply. Escape and interrupted gestures restore the prior provisional edit; coupled placement and formula-driven lengths stay controlled by their relations.

Agents can inspect exact sketch-cell identities and local dimensions through paged reads and complete reference chunks. Proposed-source reads prepare correlated source/parameter/selection changes without writing or certifying downstream solids; one atomic edit and native build retain the existing validation and Undo contracts.
